prompt: Create a polished full-page DESKTOP marketing website design study for FAROS. Output one single tall page, 1440px wide by approximately 2900px tall (desktop page screenshot, NOT a narrow mobile layout). Use the attached six-direction design board as art-direction inspiration; reproduce neither its invented product claims nor its generic Violet Circuit name. Real product is faros, an operating system for AI-native platforms used by business users and AI agents. Retain Faros brand fonts: wide Archivo for headings, Instrument Sans for body, IBM Plex Mono only for small meaningful technical labels. All text readable and intentional. Top navigation faros / Platform / Developers / Docs / Request a demo. Primary action Request a demo; secondary Understand the platform. No cards or bento, no dashboard screenshots or fake application windows, no binary text or floating orbs. Each scene must flow into the next as one artwork. Use four spacious scenes, strong negative space, changes in scale, no grid or repetitive rows. Content: hero 'Intelligence, with a place to go.' and 'Build, run, and govern the platform your business users and agents work on.'; middle 'A system of possibilities.' with Applications / Agents / Infrastructure; governance 'Freedom to build. Boundaries by design.' with short copy 'Workspaces scope resources and access. People and agents reach the same resources through APIs and MCP.'; final 'What will you connect?' with Request a demo. Do not add metrics, testimonials, invented capabilities, decorative kickers, or section numbers. This should look like an exquisitely crafted marketing site, not a moodboard or diagram collection. FOCUS ON COLUMN ONE of attached board: THE LIVING SCHEMATIC. Cool off-white #f1f1f6 ground, ink #14152a and violet #6b48e8. An enormous sparse technical schematic actively constructs itself THROUGH the page. Fine graphite neutral orthogonal paths with small rounded elbows, violet only on selected activated segments and tiny junction dots/squares. Each connection has spatial purpose: entering from edges, splitting around typography, rejoining, carrying the eye from scene to scene. Hero left half and top-middle, schematic occupies right half then travels under text and across full width into second scene. Route labels only APIs, MCP, Workspaces, Providers, People, Agents in tiny mono. Next large graphic passage resolves about 25 separated path fragments into one coherent topology; it is built into the page ground, never in a rectangle beside text. Third scene topology thins back to a precisely bounded connection; closing routes resolve toward CTA. Editorial reading rhythm of column one, crafted line intersections, lots of negative space and widely varied density, no huge webs of hundreds of parallel wires. Keep Archivo sans instead of reference serif. No pictures, screens, illustrative hardware, 3D, luminous orbs or particles. Neutral structure and violet active segments must be clearly distinct, so the visual language communicates dormant versus connected.
